reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact native source, enlarged source page 07 and targeted source panel/note crops, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution face and returned-note crops, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference

remaining_reasons: The source visibly has close-cropped brown/gray-brown hair at the sides of the high bald crown. The returned native face crop removes all visible side hair and leaves a completely smooth yellow head. Restore the source's short side hair without adding crown density.
The source's dark eyebrow group is clearly visible, but the return has no visible eyebrows above the eyes. Restore the source-scale dark eyebrows.

The enlarged source note has two compact upper gray-mark rows, while the native-resolution return has three distinct rows. Remove the invented third row and restore only the source's two-row upper footprint.
entries.positive_observation: The high crown, nearly frontal slightly viewer-left pose, single closed mouth and chest-up crop remain, with no spectacles or added beard. The dark olive uniform retains red-and-gold collar patches, gold viewer-left shoulder trim and a small pale-gray throat detail; the note still occludes much of the viewer-right chest. The rounded lower head meets the collar without a separate long yellow stalk. The complete tilted dark frame, opaque gray-olive photographic backing, warm-cream note and small right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte outer ring. These positives do not offset the clearly missing hair/eyebrows and added note row listed above.
entries.visible_limitations: The narrow upper-lip dark pixels do not reliably distinguish a fine moustache from shadow, and the small throat detail is partly occluded; neither is used as an additional rejection reason. Exact tiny insignia are also unreadable. The missing side hair, missing dark eyebrows and two-to-three note-row change are all clearly visible.
